app-links.description: What the ArkAgent app, once it is showing in the window, may ask of the desktop: open a web address in the person's own browser, and nothing else. It is how the 'Get a key' links on the Models screen reach a provider's site. Web addresses only; no folder, no program, no file.

default.description: What the setup window is allowed to do. Commands this app defines are always callable; everything under core: is not, and has to be granted here.
